{{Short description|Dutch mathematician and computer scientist}}
'''Hans Zantema''' (1956 - 28 January 2025<ref name=":0">{{cite web |url=https://www.ru.nl/en/about-us/news/in-memoriam-hans-zantema |title=In Memoriam Hans Zantema {{!}} Radboud University |date=2025-01-31|work=www.ru.nl}}</ref>) was a Dutch mathematician and computer scientist, and professor at [[Radboud University]] in Nijmegen, known for his work on [[termination analysis]].<ref>Arts, Thomas, and Jürgen Giesl. "Termination of term rewriting using dependency pairs." ''Theoretical Computer Science'' 236.1 (2000): 133-178.</ref><ref>Ohlebusch, Enno. ''Advanced topics in term rewriting.'' Springer, 2002.</ref>

== Biography ==
Born in [[Goingarijp]], the Netherlands, Zantema received his PhD in [[algebraic number theory]] in 1983 at the [[University of Amsterdam]] under supervision of [[Hendrik Lenstra]] Jr. for the thesis, entitled "Integer Valued Polynomials in Algebraic Number Theory."<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=49612}}</ref>

After graduation, Zantema spent a few years of employment in the industry before he switched to computer science: from 1987 to 2000 at [[Utrecht University]] and since 2000 at [[Eindhoven University of Technology]].

Since 2007 he was also a part-time full professor at [[Radboud University]] in Nijmegen. His main achievements are in [[rewriting|term rewriting systems]], in particular in automatically proving [[termination proof|termination]] of term rewriting. His name is attached to 
Zantema's problem,<ref>Thierry Coquand and Henrik Persson. A proof-theoretical investigation of Zantema's problem. Computer Science Logic. Lecture Notes in Computer Science Volume 1414, pp. 177-188, Springer, 1988.</ref> namely whether the string rewrite system ''0011 -> 111000'' terminates.

He also contributed to the theory and especially the visualisation of streams. This led to the book "Playing with Infinity".<ref>Hans Zantema. Playing with Infinity: Turtles, Patterns and Pictures, CRC Press, 2024.</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* Zantema, Hans. 1983. ''Integer Valued Polynomials in Algebraic Number Theory.'' PhD thesis 
* Zantema, Hans. 2007 ''De achterkant van Sudoku. Oplossen, programmeren en ontwerpen''. Aramith Hersengymnastiek.

Articles, a selection:
* Zantema, Hans. "Termination of term rewriting: interpretation and type elimination." ''Journal of Symbolic Computation'' 17.1 (1994): 23–50.
* Zantema, Hans. "[https://dspace.library.uu.nl/bitstream/handle/1874/17063/zantema_93_termination.pdf?sequence=2&isAllowed=y Termination of term rewriting by semantic labelling]." ''Fundamenta Informaticae'' 24.1 (1995): 89-105.
* Endrullis, Jörg, Johannes Waldmann, and Hans Zantema. "[http://joerg.endrullis.de/jambox/bib/matrix2008.pdf Matrix interpretations for proving termination of term rewriting] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20141022233029/http://joerg.endrullis.de/jambox/bib/matrix2008.pdf |date=2014-10-22 }}." ''Journal of Automated Reasoning'' 40.2-3 (2008): 195–220.
